rewrites.comment: React Navigation emits real hrefs (/Camera, /Settings), so a refresh or a shared link has to resolve to the single document. Vercel checks the filesystem before rewrites, so real assets are unaffected.

headers.comment: A stale service worker pins the whole app to an old build, so it must always be revalidated.
Expo fingerprints these, so a stale hit is never the wrong file.
